elegance.definition:
n. a refined quality of gracefulness and good taste
n. a quality of neatness and ingenious simplicity in the solution of a problem (especially in science or mathematics)
elegance.translation: n. 高雅, 典雅, 优雅

elegances.definition:
plural of elegance
n. a refined quality of gracefulness and good taste
n. a quality of neatness and ingenious simplicity in the solution of a problem (especially in science or mathematics)
elegances.translation: (elegance 的复数) n. 高雅, 典雅, 优雅

elegancies.definition:
plural of elegancy
n. The state or quality of being elegant; beauty as
   resulting from choice qualities and the complete absence of what
   deforms or impresses unpleasantly; grace given by art or practice; fine
   polish; refinement; -- said of manners, language, style, form,
   architecture, etc.
n. That which is elegant; that which is tasteful and highly
   attractive.
elegancies.translation: (elegancy 的复数) n. 雅致, 优美, 漂亮

elegancy.definition:
n. The state or quality of being elegant; beauty as
   resulting from choice qualities and the complete absence of what
   deforms or impresses unpleasantly; grace given by art or practice; fine
   polish; refinement; -- said of manners, language, style, form,

n. That which is elegant; that which is tasteful and highly

elegancy.translation: n. 雅致, 优美, 漂亮

elegant.definition:
a. refined and tasteful in appearance or behavior or style
s. suggesting taste, ease, and wealth
s. displaying effortless beauty and simplicity in movement or execution
elegant.translation: a. 优雅的, 端庄的, 高雅的

elegantly.definition:
r. with elegance; in a tastefully elegant manner
r. in a gracefully elegant manner

elegent.translation: a. 雅致的, 优美的

elegiac.definition:
a. resembling or characteristic of or appropriate to an elegy
s. expressing sorrow often for something past
elegiac.translation:
n. 哀歌, 挽歌
a. 哀歌体的, 挽歌的

elegiac couplet.translation: n. 挽歌对句; 挽联

elegiac stanza.translation: （由五音步组成抑扬格、韵律为abab的）挽歌诗节

elegiacal.translation: a. 挽歌体的, 哀悼的, 表示悲哀的

elegies.translation: n. 哀歌, 挽歌( elegy的名词复数 )

elegist.definition: n. the author of a mournful poem lamenting the dead

elegit.definition:
n. A judicial writ of execution, by which a defendant's goods
   are appraised and delivered to the plaintiff, and, if not sufficient to
   satisfy the debt, all of his lands are delivered, to be held till the
   debt is paid by the rents and profits, or until the defendant's
   interest has expired.

elegize.translation:
vt. 以挽歌哀悼
vi. 作哀歌

elegized.translation: v. 作挽歌祭引, 作哀歌( elegize的过去式和过去分词 )

elegizes.translation: v. 作挽歌祭引, 作哀歌( elegize的第三人称单数 )

elegizing.translation: v. 作挽歌祭引, 作哀歌( elegize的现在分词 )

elegy.definition: n. a mournful poem; a lament for the dead
elegy.translation: n. 悲歌, 哀歌, 挽歌
